name: Sherlock - The Pendant Soldiers
source:
Set after the last episode of the series, Sherlock Holmes takes on a new case, one that at first seems quite simple and easy to manage.
But one thing leads to another, and soon he and John Watson are involved in a dangerous, complex mystery, unsure who is pulling at the strings.

[From [url=http://y0do.deviantart.com/gallery/27174625#/d3d2u7u]Deviant Art[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在电视剧最终集之后。夏洛克·福尔摩斯接下了一桩新案件，起初看来既简单又容易处理。然而，事情接二连三地发生，他与约翰·华生很快便被卷入一场危险而复杂的谜局，甚至不知道究竟是谁在幕后操纵一切。

[译自 [url=http://y0do.deviantart.com/gallery/27174625#/d3d2u7u]DeviantArt[/url]]
